newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, await NYMEX's direction.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, await NYMEX's direction.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday with some support from crude.
Fuel oil was steady to firmer. Barges were $4 higher on tight supply while cargoes rose slightly.
Gas oil prices fell $3.25 a tonne on IPE futures. Premiums were stable but volumes were thin with traders awaiting direction from NYMEX.
Naphtha rallied to catch up to crude's gains on Monday and as Algeria's Skikda port remained shut.
Gasoline rose slightly but traders awaited U.S. inventory data and watched the Elf refinery strikes.
